family.description: Game family name (chess, draughts, go, reversi, shogi, xiangqi, mancala, morris, hex, landlords-game, backgammon, standard-52, bavarian-32, flower-48, double-six-dominoes, mahjong, standard-dice, agon, asalto, chaupar, dou-shou-qi, fanorona, halma, nyout, pachisi, royal-ur, senet, stern-halma, surakarta, tafl)

tools.name: play_get_moves
tools.description: Get all legal moves for the current position. Requires state from play_create_game or play_apply_move.

state.description: Game state object returned by play_create_game or play_apply_move

tools.name: play_apply_move
tools.description: Apply a move to the game and return the new state. Pass the move object exactly as returned by play_get_moves (format varies by family: chess uses {from,to}, go uses {coord} or {action:"pass"}).

state.description: Game state object from play_create_game or a previous play_apply_move

move.description: Move object from play_get_moves (e.g. {from:"e2",to:"e4"} for chess, {coord:40} for go, {action:"pass"})

tools.name: play_check_status
tools.description: Check the current game status: whose turn it is, whether the game is over, and who won.

state.description: Game state object from play_create_game or play_apply_move

tools.name: play_suggest_move
tools.description: Use AI to analyse the position and suggest the best move. Supports 5 difficulty levels across all 30 playable families.

state.description: Game state object from play_create_game or play_apply_move

tools.name: play_render_board
tools.description: Render the current board position as SVG for any playable family (chess, draughts, go, reversi, shogi, xiangqi, mancala, morris, hex, landlords-game, backgammon, standard-52, bavarian-32, flower-48, double-six-dominoes, mahjong, standard-dice, agon, asalto, chaupar, dou-shou-qi, fanorona, halma, nyout, pachisi, royal-ur, senet, stern-halma, surakarta, tafl).

state.description: Game state object from play_create_game or play_apply_move

size.description: Board width in pixels for PNG output (default: 480, max: 2048)

tools.name: play_export_fen
tools.description: Export the current board position as a FEN-style setup string, in the form the variant's own frontmatter declares its starting position. Card, tile and dice games have no board position to export.

state.description: Game state object from play_create_game or play_apply_move

tools.name: play_load_fen
tools.description: Create a game from a FEN-style setup string, as returned by play_export_fen. Pass the same variant the position was exported from.

family.description: Game family (chess, draughts, go, reversi, shogi, xiangqi, mancala, morris, hex, landlords-game, backgammon, standard-52, bavarian-32, flower-48, double-six-dominoes, mahjong, standard-dice, agon, asalto, chaupar, dou-shou-qi, fanorona, halma, nyout, pachisi, royal-ur, senet, stern-halma, surakarta, tafl)

fen.description: Position string in FEN-style notation for the family

variant.description: Optional variant slug (default: the family's default game)

tools.name: play_validate_move
tools.description: Check whether a move is legal in the current position without applying it. Pass the move object in the same format as play_get_moves returns.

state.description: Game state object from play_create_game or play_apply_move

move.description: Move object to validate (same format as play_get_moves output)

tools.name: play_make_moves
tools.description: Apply a sequence of moves to a game and return the final state. Stops at the first illegal move. Move objects must match play_get_moves format.

state.description: Game state object from play_create_game or play_apply_move

moves.description: Array of move objects in the format returned by play_get_moves
